+

@@ -0,0 +1,82 @@
+# This file is part of Ansible
+#
+# Ansible is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
+# it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
+# the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or

+# GNU General Public License for more details.
+#
+# You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
+# along with Ansible.  If not, see <http://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware import linux
+
+
+def test_get_sysinfo_facts_absent(mocker):
+    mocker.patch.object(linux.os.path, 'exists', return_value=False)
+    get_file_lines = mocker.patch.object(linux, 'get_file_lines')
+
+    facts = linux.LinuxHardware(Mock()).get_sysinfo_facts()
+
+    assert facts == {}
+    get_file_lines.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_get_sysinfo_facts_present(mocker):
+    mocker.patch.object(linux.os.path, 'exists', return_value=True)
+    mocker.patch.object(linux, 'get_file_lines', return_value=[
+        'Manufacturer: IBM',
+        'Type: 3906',
+        'Sequence Code: 0000012345',
+        'Other: ignored',
+    ])
+
+    facts = linux.LinuxHardware(Mock()).get_sysinfo_facts()
+
+    assert facts == {
+        'system_vendor': 'IBM',
+        'product_name': '3906',
+        'product_serial': '12345',
+        'product_version': 'NA',
+        'product_uuid': 'NA',
+    }
+
+
+def test_get_sysinfo_facts_missing_fields(mocker):
+    mocker.patch.object(linux.os.path, 'exists', return_value=True)
+    mocker.patch.object(linux, 'get_file_lines', return_value=['Type:  8561  '])
+
+    facts = linux.LinuxHardware(Mock()).get_sysinfo_facts()
+
+    assert facts == {
+        'system_vendor': 'NA',
+        'product_name': '8561',
+        'product_serial': 'NA',
+        'product_version': 'NA',
+        'product_uuid': 'NA',
+    }
+
+
+def test_populate_uses_sysinfo_over_dmi(mocker):
+    module = Mock()
+    hardware = linux.LinuxHardware(module)
+    mocker.patch.object(linux, 'get_best_parsable_locale', return_value='C')
+    for method in ('get_cpu_facts', 'get_memory_facts', 'get_device_facts',
+                   'get_uptime_facts', 'get_lvm_facts', 'get_mount_facts'):
+        mocker.patch.object(hardware, method, return_value={})
+    mocker.patch.object(hardware, 'get_dmi_facts', return_value={'system_vendor': 'NA'})
+    mocker.patch.object(linux.os.path, 'exists', return_value=True)
+    mocker.patch.object(linux, 'get_file_lines', return_value=['Manufacturer: IBM'])
+
+    facts = hardware.populate()
+
+    assert facts['system_vendor'] == 'IBM'
+    assert facts['product_name'] == 'NA'
